WITH a AS (SELECT line_no, ts, node FROM bgl_logs a WHERE a.line_no = %(line_no)s),
w AS (
  SELECT l.line_no, l.ts, l.node, l.alert_label, l.component, l.level, l.message, l.line_no - a.line_no AS offset_lines,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY sign(l.line_no - a.line_no)
                            ORDER BY abs(l.line_no - a.line_no)) AS rn
  FROM bgl_logs l, a
  WHERE l.node = a.node
    AND l.ts BETWEEN a.ts - to_seconds(%(window)s) AND a.ts + to_seconds(%(window)s))
SELECT * EXCLUDE (rn) FROM w
WHERE offset_lines = 0 OR (offset_lines < 0 AND rn <= %(before)s)
   OR (offset_lines > 0 AND rn <= %(after)s)
ORDER BY line_no

WITH p AS (
  SELECT o.team, l.component, l.ts, l.message, l.node AS unit
  FROM bgl_logs l
  JOIN ownership o ON o.dataset = 'bgl' AND o.component = l.component
  WHERE l.is_alert
), bounds AS (SELECT (SELECT max(ts) FROM bgl_logs) AS end_ts)
SELECT p.team, count(*) AS problem_lines,
       count(DISTINCT regexp_replace(regexp_replace(p.message, '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}', '<uuid>', 'g'), '0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\b[0-9a-fA-F]*[0-9][0-9a-fA-F]*\b', '<*>', 'g')) AS distinct_patterns,
       count(DISTINCT p.unit) AS nodes, count(DISTINCT p.ts::DATE) AS active_days,
       min(p.ts) AS first_seen, max(p.ts) AS last_seen,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.ts >= b.end_ts - to_days(%(recent)s)) AS recent_lines,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.ts >= b.end_ts - to_days(2 * %(recent)s)
                          AND p.ts < b.end_ts - to_days(%(recent)s)) AS previous_lines
FROM p, bounds b
GROUP BY p.team
ORDER BY problem_lines DESC

cases.sql:
WITH steps AS (
  SELECT l.is_anomaly, l.instance_id,
         regexp_extract(l.message, 'Took [0-9.]+ seconds to (.*?)\.?$', 1) AS step,
         regexp_extract(l.message, 'Took ([0-9.]+) seconds', 1)::DOUBLE AS seconds
  FROM openstack_logs l
  WHERE l.component = 'nova.compute.manager' AND regexp_matches(l.message, 'Took [0-9.]+ seconds to ')
)
SELECT step, CASE WHEN is_anomaly THEN 'anomalous' ELSE 'normal' END AS instances,
       count(*) AS samples, round(avg(seconds), 2) AS avg_s, round(min(seconds), 2) AS min_s,
       round(quantile_cont(seconds, 0.5), 2) AS p50_s, round(quantile_cont(seconds, 0.95), 2) AS p95_s,
       round(max(seconds), 2) AS max_s
FROM steps
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY step, instances
